file_changes.purpose: Define the repo-spec runtime package boundary and public versioned API surface.
implementation: Declare the package as the FS0-Core runtime implementation namespace.
Export only stable entry points needed by the CLI and later functional sets.
Do not embed normative semantics in module constants; normative authority remains in Planning/Governance artifacts.

file_changes.purpose: Provide typed failure classes that preserve phase ownership and prevent downstream repair of upstream defects.
implementation: Define base RepoSpecError plus DesignError, PlanningError, ConformanceError, AssuranceError, BuildError, GovernanceError.
Include machine-readable code, human message, optional artifact/path context, and owning_phase.
Provide a routing helper that maps Design defects to Design, planning defects to Planning, and realization defects to Build without mutating artifacts.

file_changes.purpose: Provide deterministic JSON loading/writing and repository-relative path safety used by all FS0 artifacts.
implementation: Load UTF-8 JSON with duplicate-key rejection and explicit parse errors.
Write canonical UTF-8 JSON with stable indentation and newline termination.
Resolve repository-relative paths while rejecting absolute paths and parent traversal.
Expose SHA-format validation and deterministic content hashing helpers without assigning semantic authority to hashes.

file_changes.purpose: Resolve and mechanically validate canonical Markdown Design Proposals and selected DP statements.
implementation: Parse the YAML-like metadata header using a minimal deterministic parser for the known Design Proposal metadata keys.
Verify doc_id format, artifact_type, canonical_format, dependencies, exact 16 level-two headers in canonical order, stable Section ID values, and unique DP statement IDs.
Resolve declared proposal dependencies from the functional-set Design inputs.
Given a functional-set Design input, verify path, exact revision token, doc_id, and existence/ownership of every selected statement.
Return a non-normative DesignIndex containing addresses and source locations only.
Expose a Design Assurance subject summary containing exact proposal revision, declared dependencies, section completeness, and statement index without deciding semantic readiness mechanically.

file_changes.purpose: Load and validate functional-set.json as the bounded Design scope for one Planning cycle.
implementation: Load functional-set.schema.json and validate the subset of JSON Schema constructs used by the bootstrap contracts with stdlib-only code.
Verify canonical directory/order identity, including 000_FS0-CORE for core and order >=1 for extensions.
Verify accepted predecessor shape and exact Design-input revision bindings.
Call design.py to resolve all selected DP statements and reject references outside declared Design inputs.
Return a FunctionalSet object containing scope only; reject Plan-owned fields.

file_changes.purpose: Represent Planning-owned normative requirements, applicability dispositions, and non-circular ownership relationships.
implementation: Define immutable NormativeRequirement records with stable ID, one obligation statement, Conformance disposition, and Assurance disposition.
Validate requirement IDs and uniqueness.
Require rationale whenever either applicability is none.
Represent controlling-owner and normative dependency relationships separately from Design addresses.
Provide cycle detection over normative dependency edges and enforce one controlling owner per independently governed invariant.
Represent stable authority identities and explicit delegation edges; reject unresolved delegated authority and authority edges inferred from implementation or historical state.
Represent derived primitive provenance to authorizing normative authority and keystone responsibility.
Represent normative lifecycle status and predecessor/successor identity for creation, amendment, supersession, and withdrawal while preserving historical resolution.
Enforce default-deny lookup: governed framework state without resolvable accepted authorization or a governed extension point is rejected rather than inferred as authorized.
Represent framework authority and product authority as distinct domains and reject product-originating attempts to define framework authority.

file_changes.purpose: Load, validate, and mechanically assess executable Plan artifacts.
implementation: Load plan.schema.json and validate all schema constructs used by the Plan contract with stdlib-only code.
Resolve the referenced functional-set artifact and require matching functional_set.id.
Require implementation_predecessor.repository_revision to equal the functional-set accepted predecessor for the first Plan and later governed predecessor rules.
Validate normative requirement uniqueness and applicability records through normative.py.
Validate unique repository-relative file paths, legal operations, non-empty implementation steps, requirement references, validation references, dependency paths, and generated consequences.
Validate execution step numbering, referenced paths, invariant IDs, validation IDs, and completion-condition references.

Perform executability preflight: reject duplicate/conflicting operations, unresolved dependencies, path traversal, impossible delete/modify assumptions expressible from declared operation semantics, and unauthorized paths outside Plan scope.
Return a frozen Plan model consumed by Build; never rewrite Plan intent during Build.

file_changes.purpose: Record governed semantic-review results for Design readiness, Planning sufficiency, and Build fidelity.
implementation: Define AssuranceFinding and AssuranceReport records with phase, subject identity, disposition, rationale, and evidence references.
Support design, planning, and build review phases.

Require Planning Assurance to explicitly address Design fidelity, functional-set coherence/manageability, normative distillation, semantic invention, file-scope completeness, implementation detail, invariants, validation, and executability.
Require Build Assurance to address Plan fidelity, Design-through-Plan fidelity, operational adequacy, material edge/failure behavior, unauthorized improvisation, and evidence sufficiency.
Do not mutate normative authority; findings route persistent meaning defects to Design and distillation/intent defects to Planning.
Require Design Assurance reports to address clarity, completeness, consistency, architecture/boundaries, ambiguity, omissions, alternatives/tradeoffs, risks, and blocking questions.

For FS0 bootstrap only, accept the pre-Build Planning Assurance decision as externally produced Governance evidence; the candidate runtime's planning-assure command validates capability for later functional sets and cannot self-authorize the Plan that creates it.

file_changes.purpose: Provide mechanical Design, functional-set, Plan, and Build Conformance for the self-hosting workflow.
implementation: Expose conformance entry points for design, functional-set, plan, and build subjects.
Design Conformance delegates structural checks to design.py.
Functional-set Conformance delegates scope and reference checks to functional_set.py.
Plan Conformance delegates schema, identity, path, dependency, and executability checks to plan.py.

Build Conformance compares actual mutation manifest to accepted Plan paths, validates generated consequences, executes applicable syntax/parse/compile commands, executes Plan validation commands, repository validation, and end-to-end operational checks.
Produce structured mechanical findings only; never create or amend semantics.
Serialize each Conformance execution to a conformance-report.schema.json-valid report with stable identity and subject/evidence references.
Mechanically enforce default-deny governed-state authorization where authorization relationships are structurally resolvable.
Validate Build mutation manifests against build-manifest.schema.json and accepted Plan scope.

file_changes.purpose: Execute an accepted Plan through an authorized actor while enforcing mutation scope and producing Build evidence.
implementation: Define BuildSession from an accepted immutable Plan plus implementation predecessor.
Before any mutation, assert current implementation state matches the declared implementation predecessor or an explicitly authorized Planning-artifact-only descendant.
Expose authorized path/operation queries used by the AI or human Build actor before writes.
Record every observed mutation into a mutation manifest and reject paths/operations outside the Plan.
Do not synthesize source from pseudo-code automatically; Build actors implement the Plan, while this module enforces authorization and records evidence.
Route discovered upstream defects through typed errors rather than expanding scope.
Finalize only after Build Conformance and Build Assurance reports pass.
Persist the observed mutation manifest in the schema-defined representation before Build Conformance.
Use repository.py for predecessor/Planning-descendant checks and mutation observation; do not scatter Git-state interpretation across Build logic.

file_changes.purpose: Provide explicit non-circular acceptance, provenance, governed state advancement, and authority boundaries.
implementation: Define governed artifact identities and acceptance records for Design readiness, Planning acceptance, and Build acceptance.
Require acceptance records to identify subject, actor, decision, predecessor authority, evidence references, and resulting state without deriving authority from incidental Git/platform events.
Reject acceptance prerequisites that depend on authority created only by the candidate acceptance itself.

Record lineage from functional-set Design inputs through Planning normative requirements, accepted Plan revision, Build mutation manifest, Conformance evidence, Assurance evidence, and accepted implementation state.
Enforce keystone separation: Governance consumes Conformance and Assurance evidence but does not perform their judgments.
Advance accepted implementation state only on explicit Build acceptance.
Represent explicit rejection records preserving candidate identity, rejection reason, and provenance; rejection never promotes state.
Represent governed state and authorization scope explicitly and apply default-deny when no accepted authority or governed extension point resolves.
Resolve keystone delegation through explicit accepted authority relationships before permitting governed actions.
Maintain stable identities for Design revisions, Planning work, accepted Plans, Build work, and Build results.
Maintain normative lifecycle history for creation, amendment, supersession, and withdrawal without identity reuse.
Reference durable Conformance reports, Assurance reports, and Build mutation manifests in acceptance lineage.

file_changes.purpose: Expose the minimum self-hosting workflow as deterministic command-line entry points for AI and human actors.
implementation: Provide subcommands: design-check, design-assure, functional-set-check, plan-check, planning-assure, plan-accept, build-open, build-check, build-assure, build-accept, status.
All commands accept explicit repository root and artifact paths; no hidden current-directory authority.
Return nonzero on failed Conformance/Assurance/acceptance and emit deterministic JSON summaries suitable for agent use.
CLI dispatches to domain modules and contains no independent policy semantics.

file_changes.purpose: Allow the runtime to be invoked as python -m repo_spec.
implementation: Import cli.main and exit with its integer return code.
Contain no policy or workflow logic.

file_changes.purpose: Define the minimum durable semantic-review evidence representation used by FS0 Planning and Build acceptance.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for Assurance report identity, phase, subject, exact artifact revision, reviewer/actor identity, disposition pass/fail, required review criteria, findings, rationale, and evidence references.
Keep case findings non-normative and require explicit routing target when disposition fails because upstream correction is needed.

file_changes.purpose: Define durable Governance acceptance and lineage records without circular self-authorization.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for acceptance identity, stage, subject artifact identity/revision, actor, decision, authority prerequisites, Conformance evidence refs, Assurance evidence refs, predecessor implementation state, and resulting accepted state.
Forbid using the resulting acceptance identity/state as one of its own authority prerequisites.
Require build acceptance to identify the resulting accepted implementation repository revision.

file_changes.purpose: Verify canonical Design parsing, identities, dependency resolution, and exact selected-statement addressing.
implementation: Create temporary valid and invalid Design Proposal fixtures in test code.
Assert malformed headers, duplicate statements, wrong section order, unresolved dependencies, and wrong statement ownership fail.
Assert exact revision binding is preserved as data and later Design content cannot silently replace the bound input.

file_changes.purpose: Verify functional-set, normative, Plan, Planning Assurance, and executability rules.
implementation: Construct minimal temporary functional-set and Plan artifacts.
Assert core/extension identity rules, scope-only functional-set behavior, normative ID uniqueness, applicability rationale, owner uniqueness, and dependency cycle rejection.
Assert duplicate/conflicting paths, missing implementation steps, unresolved validation IDs, missing dependency paths, and predecessor mismatch fail Plan Conformance.
Assert Planning Assurance requires every semantic criterion before pass.
Assert delegated authority must resolve explicitly, derived primitives without authority provenance fail, and product authority cannot define framework authority.
Assert Design Assurance cannot pass until every required semantic-readiness criterion is explicitly dispositioned.
Assert lifecycle history preserves superseded/withdrawn normative identities and rejects identity reuse.

file_changes.purpose: Verify Build scope enforcement, Conformance, Assurance, provenance, non-circular acceptance, and state advancement.
implementation: Open a BuildSession around a minimal accepted Plan and temporary repository.
Assert unauthorized paths and operations fail immediately.
Assert Build cannot finalize without required mechanical and semantic evidence.
Assert acceptance cannot self-authorize or arise from incidental repository state.
Assert successful acceptance preserves full lineage and advances the accepted implementation state.
Assert Assurance findings cannot directly mutate normative authority.
Assert governed state with no resolvable accepted authorization or governed extension point is rejected by default.
Assert rejection preserves candidate, reason, and provenance and does not advance accepted state.
Assert Conformance reports and Build manifests are durable, identity-bearing, and resolvable from acceptance lineage.

file_changes.purpose: Own explicit repository/revision semantics used for exact Design reads, implementation-predecessor checks, mutation observation, and resulting revision identity.
implementation: Define Repository rooted at an explicit filesystem path and reject implicit authority from process current working directory.
Validate full Git revision identities and expose content-at-revision reads for Design Proposal resolution without replacing Markdown as semantic authority.
Expose exact HEAD, ancestry/descendant checks needed to distinguish implementation predecessor from later Planning-artifact-only commits, and clean/dirty working-state inspection.
Capture changed paths and operation classes relative to the declared implementation predecessor for Build mutation manifests.
Expose resulting candidate revision/state identity only as repository facts; Governance decides whether that state is accepted.
Raise typed errors when revisions are missing, ambiguous, inaccessible, or incompatible with the declared predecessor.

file_changes.purpose: Define durable machine-readable Conformance evidence for Design, functional-set, Plan, and Build acceptance decisions.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema with stable report identity, phase/subject identity, exact subject revision where applicable, check records, pass/fail disposition, evidence references, and deterministic diagnostics.
Require findings to remain mechanical and forbid fields that purport to create or amend normative semantics.
Allow Governance acceptance records to reference reports by stable identity and repository path/revision.

file_changes.purpose: Define durable Build mutation evidence required for Plan-scope Conformance and Governance lineage.
implementation: Define Draft 2020-12 JSON schema for manifest identity, implementation predecessor, accepted Plan identity/revision, candidate state, and ordered observed mutations.
Each mutation records repository-relative path, observed operation, applicable planned operation, and generated consequence relationship where relevant.
Require every manifest path to be unique and prohibit absolute or parent-traversal paths.

ordered_steps.description: Establish shared runtime foundations and Design/functional-set resolution.
Implement Planning normative and Plan models plus Planning Assurance.
Implement workflow Conformance, Build authorization/evidence, Governance acceptance, and CLI orchestration.
Define durable Assurance and acceptance evidence schemas.
Run Planning, Build, repository, and self-hosting validation to prove FS0-Core can support the next functional set.

invariants.statement: Design Proposal Markdown and DP statement IDs remain non-normative inputs; only Planning-created normative requirements become Plan authority.
The implementation predecessor is distinct from the later repository revision containing accepted Planning artifacts.
Build mutation authority is exactly the accepted Plan file scope; Planning-artifact commits do not implicitly expand implementation authority.
Governance, Conformance, and Assurance remain separate authorities and none may create authority reserved to another keystone.
No candidate acceptance may depend on authority that exists only as a consequence of that same acceptance.
A successful accepted Build becomes the implementation predecessor for the next functional set while preserving complete lineage to Design, Plan, evidence, and acceptance.
Governed framework state is default-deny: absence of resolvable accepted authorization or a governed extension point is a rejection condition, not permission to infer authority.

Every maintained derived framework primitive and governed action resolves through explicit authority provenance and delegation; implementation and product state cannot manufacture framework authority.
Rejection and normative lifecycle transitions preserve historical identity and provenance without silently promoting rejected or superseded state.
Every accepted normative identity represents one independently governable, self-contained rule using accepted normative force and containing no implementation or evidentiary material.
Governance authority derives from accepted authority relationships rather than from actor capability or repository/platform manipulation capability.

validation.description: Validate the canonical Design Proposal corpus structurally and resolve FS0-selected DP statements.
validation.success_criteria: All consumed Design Proposals and selected DP statements resolve without structural or identity errors.

validation.description: Validate FS0-Core functional-set scope against the functional-set schema and Design inputs.
validation.success_criteria: The functional set is schema-valid, canonically identified, exact-revision bound, and every selected statement resolves.

validation.description: Validate FS0-Core Plan schema, normative identities, file scope, references, and mechanical executability.
validation.success_criteria: The Plan is schema-valid and no impossible, conflicting, unauthorized, or unresolved operation is known before Build.

validation.description: Check Assurance report schema JSON syntax; semantic schema-contract behavior is verified by the FS0 unit suite.
validation.success_criteria: The schema parses as JSON; FS0 unit tests validate all Draft 2020-12 constructs used by the schema and reject invalid report examples.

validation.description: Check Governance acceptance schema JSON syntax; semantic schema-contract behavior is verified by the FS0 unit suite.
validation.success_criteria: The schema parses as JSON; FS0 unit tests validate all schema constructs and reject circular or incomplete acceptance examples.

validation.description: Run the FS0-Core stdlib unit test suite.
validation.success_criteria: All FS0-Core unit tests pass with no third-party Python dependencies.

validation.description: Bootstrap Planning Assurance for FS0-Core performed against Design + functional-set + Plan before candidate FS0 runtime exists.
validation.success_criteria: An explicit PASS review confirms exact Design fidelity, functional-set coherence/manageability, atomic normative distillation under the Governance normative-statement contract, absence of semantic invention, exact file-scope completeness, implementation-detail sufficiency, invariants, validation, executability, and actor-authority boundaries.

validation.description: Perform Build Conformance against the accepted Plan and observed mutation manifest.
validation.success_criteria: All observed mutations are authorized, all declared generated consequences are current, all prescribed validations pass, and the FS0 operational workflow passes.

validation.description: Demonstrate that FS0-Core can execute the next full Design→Planning→Build governance cycle using temporary extension artifacts.
validation.success_criteria: The runtime can validate and Design-assure a proposal, validate a new extension functional set and Plan, Planning-assure and explicitly accept that Plan, open a BuildSession, enforce default-deny authority and mutation scope, produce durable Build/Conformance/Assurance evidence, and explicitly accept the resulting state without out-of-band framework logic.

validation.description: Run the complete canonical FS0-Core validation sequence.
validation.success_criteria: Design, functional-set, Plan, tests, Planning Assurance, Build Conformance, Build Assurance prerequisites, provenance, and acceptance-state checks all pass.

validation.description: Check Conformance-report and Build-manifest schema syntax and validate their used schema contracts through the FS0 unit suite.
validation.success_criteria: Both evidence schemas parse as JSON and FS0 unit tests accept valid examples and reject invalid identity, path, evidence, and mutation records.

completion_conditions.statement: All files listed by the Plan exist with the planned semantics and no implementation file outside the accepted Plan scope is required for FS0-Core operation.
The canonical Design Proposal corpus and FS0 functional set validate and all selected DP statements resolve at their exact bound revisions.
The FS0 Plan validates mechanically and Planning Assurance passes with no unresolved Design or Planning defect.
Build Conformance and the complete repository validation sequence pass.
The self-hosting operational check proves FS0-Core can validate and govern the next extension functional-set Planning→Build cycle without out-of-band framework logic.
Governance can record explicit non-circular Build acceptance that advances the accepted implementation state and preserves resolvable lineage.

Default-deny governed-state authorization, explicit delegation resolution, derived-primitive provenance, product/framework separation, rejection preservation, and normative lifecycle history are all mechanically and semantically demonstrated.
Durable Conformance reports and Build mutation manifests are schema-valid and resolvable from Governance acceptance lineage.
FS0 bootstrap Planning Assurance is completed without relying on the candidate FS0 runtime, while the built runtime demonstrates Planning Assurance capability for subsequent functional sets.
All FS0 normative requirements satisfy the accepted normative-statement contract and all governed actor operations enforce explicit authority independent of actor capability.
